metadata.cellContract: safeRows[row][column]=1 certifies the complete closed 2m square for a 6m-radius USV; rows south-to-north, columns west-to-east; center=min+(index+0.5)*resolution; outside bounds is unavailable
metadata.corridorContract: Only exact centerline points/segments are supplementary water; clearanceM is hull clearance, NOT lateral center freedom; every complete capsule is checked against the same geometry
metadata.geometryContract: All world-space terrain triangles clipped at ENU up=0 and conservatively projected to ENU; waterline-intersecting original structure renderer AABBs are obstacles; no finite ray sampling
